text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway when I
hear voices
from inside a classroom.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm, can we take a break? I think my
head's
starting to overheat from all these
explanations!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We just had a break. Please, pay attention!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You look cuter when you smile, Flash. ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you would focus and listen to what I'm
saying,
I'd be smiling.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... But this stuff about triangles and
linear
equations is all Greek to me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I could focus if it was Umadol stuff like
dancing
and singing...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
All right.
Then let's pretend this is about

Umadols.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The tests are your concerts, and the
lessons are your rehearsals. So if you
don't learn these
formulas, what does
that make you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm... An Umadol who doesn't
memorize the
lyrics?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! But then... that means I've
been...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! Where's my Umadol pride?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols always stay on top of their
duties and
shine with all their might!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well said! Then I take it you know what
needs to
be done?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I've gotta rehearse! I'll head down
to the
studio and practice my dance
routine right away!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...My best efforts, all for nothing. Who
can make
her figure this out?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me. If you have time, would
you mind
giving her a word of advice?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aww, do I really have to study?
choice_data_list: Don't slack off on your studies ei...
Give it your all and chase your dream!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Don't get so down. Studying is just like
dance
lessons—you learn as you go!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you never cut corners with
anything,
right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, I guess not. I always take
everything very
seriously as an Umadol!
But...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: See, the word "everything" refers quite literally to every thing, which of course includes—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, I get it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon practically cries out the
words, but
eventually starts to study
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to shine, body and soul!
Which
means... time for dance
practice! ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, that's not the conclusion you
were
supposed to...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sigh. We were supposed to study for 39 more minutes. My schedule...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon successfully escapes
studying and
throws her whole soul into
her dance lessons.
